725:t_026:0.en:
$$ズール$$
「Why?! Why can't I defeat them?!」

725:t_026:1.en:
$$ズール$$
「I am Emperor $$ズール$$! The one who rules the entire universe in place of the $$御使い$$!」

725:t_026:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's over, $$ズール$$! Now you will pay for taking innocent lives!」

725:t_026:3.en:
$$ズール$$
「Silence, $$マーズ$$! If only $$イデア$$ hadn't sent even the Six God Robots to Earth back then, this would never have...!」

725:t_026:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「The love of my father on $$ギシン星$$ saved me, the love of my father and mother on Earth raised me, $$マーグ$$'s love guided me, and $$ロゼ$$'s love makes me strong!」

725:t_026:5.en:
$$ズール$$
「Love?! Will I, $$ズール$$, be defeated by something like love?!」

725:t_026:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's right! There's no place in this universe for someone who doesn't understand the meaning of love!」

725:t_026:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Vanish into the darkness, $$ズール$$! I won't hand you the light of this world!」

725:t_027:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Yeah... $$ズール$$'s soul fell completely into the darkness. Now he will never come back to this world.」

725:t_027:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「If this world gets swallowed by the darkness... by the force that seeks to vanish, $$ズール$$ might regain his power.」

725:t_027:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's why we have to protect this universe and fill it with light.」

725:t_027:6.en:
$$タケル$$
(So, Brother, I'll keep fighting until the day we win back peace...)

725:t_027:7.en:
$$タケル$$
(Together with your soul and this $$ゴッドマーズ$$)

725:t_100:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Today we settle this once and for all, $$ハーデス$$!」

725:t_100:1.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「A mere human dares speak to the King of the Underworld as an equal?!」

725:t_100:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Admit it, $$ハーデス$$! They have raised themselves to the point of walking alongside us. They are our new kin!」

725:t_100:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Silence, $$ゼウス$$! And that is because you lent them a hand!」

725:t_100:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That is not so! They overcame the light and darkness within themselves by their own strength, and that is why they are here now!」

725:t_100:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「I won't admit it...! I will not admit such a thing!」

725:t_100:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then, $$ハーデス$$! Feel it with your own body!」

725:t_100:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Our anger, our fighting spirit... and our hope for the future! We will win, no matter what!!」

725:t_101:1.en:
$$ズール$$
「$$マーズ$$! Even if you have become one with $$マーグ$$, you cannot defeat me!」

725:t_101:2.en:
$$ズール$$
「I am the very darkness of the universe! I am Emperor $$ズール$$, ruler of the darkness!」

725:t_101:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Now I can even understand your darkness.」

725:t_101:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Fear, anxiety, despair - everyone has those feelings! But you lost to them, fell to them, and were stained by them!」

725:t_101:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「I can't hand the future... the love overflowing in this universe... to someone like that!」

725:t_101:7.en:
$$ズール$$
「Spare me, $$マーズ$$! Then my darkness will devour your light and take in its power!」

725:t_101:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's useless, $$ズール$$! We will make light and darkness one and go on to a new world!!」

725:t_102:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Curse you, $$金田正太郎$$! If it has come to this, I, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, will bury your hope, $$鉄人$$, with my own hands!」

725:t_102:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Words like that won't scare us! No matter how much darkness you gather, neither we nor $$鉄人$$ will be swallowed by it!」

725:t_102:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This strong will...! So that is what gives $$鉄人$$ its power!」

725:t_102:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Get ready, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$! You were swallowed by despair and became one with the darkness, and the Messenger of the Sun will defeat you!」

725:t_102:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$! This time we'll destroy the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ completely!!」

725:t_103:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Come, $$グーラ$$! I will teach you the truth of the universe once more!」

725:t_103:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The truth of the universe isn't power, Father! It's that living beings live together!」

725:t_103:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You knew that once too, Father! To make you remember it, I will defeat you!!」

725:t_104:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「You villains have no business putting on airs like gods! I, the great $$勝平$$, and $$ザンボット３$$ will blow you all away!」

725:t_104:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「We're paying you back for all the times you looked down on us! This is the end for you!!」

725:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! The sun never loses to any darkness!」

725:t_105:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「Prepare yourselves, apostles of darkness! The light of $$ダイターン３$$ will utterly shatter your darkness!」

725:t_106:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You've done evil all over the place, but this is where you finally pay for it!」

725:t_106:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready! Your threats about darkness and despair and gloom don't work on us anymore!」

725:t_107:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is the Messenger of the Sun! It's a light that won't lose even to your darkness!」

725:t_107:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm not afraid of the darkness! The light of $$鉄人$$ and me will break through it, no matter what!!」

725:t_108:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「No matter how much darkness you line up, we won't fall into it!」

725:t_108:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're human! We overcome our past wounds and regrets and keep moving toward the future!!」

725:t_109:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Too bad, you villains! Your threat with your last trump card won't work on us either!」

725:t_109:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We've come this far, so no more cheap tricks! Come at us with everything you've got!!」

725:t_110:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「We're human! Humans who live by making light and darkness one!」

725:t_110:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「We won't lose to the likes of you, who fell into darkness! Feel that power!!」

725:t_111:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I didn't come all the way here to listen to talk of darkness and despair!」

725:t_111:1.en:
$$カミナ$$
「That's right! Give 'em more, $$シモン$$!!」

725:t_111:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Get ready! I'll drill a hole right through your darkness!」

725:t_111:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「My drill pierces everything! Darkness, fear, despair!!」

725:t_112:0.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Even in the deepest darkness there is light...!」

725:t_112:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Those little flames of courage gather into a fire of hope, and then into flames that burn up our enemies!」

725:t_112:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The flames of us... of $$ガンバスター$$ won't lose to any darkness! We'll show you!!」

725:t_113:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Your bluffs don't scare us anymore! We overcame despair to be here!」

725:t_113:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go! Hope is pointing out the road we walk!」

725:t_114:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「An unyielding warrior who doesn't flinch even at the threats of the boss of evil! That's $$ノノ$$ and $c!」

725:t_114:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「An unyielding warrior who doesn't flinch even at the threats of the boss of evil! That's $$ノノ$$ and $c!」

725:t_114:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「An unyielding warrior who doesn't flinch even at the threats of the boss of evil! That's $$ノノ$$ and $c!」

725:t_114:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Your ambitions end here! Because...!」

725:t_114:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Your ambitions end here! Because...!」

725:t_114:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because $$ノノ$$ and the others are here!!」

725:t_114:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Because $$ノノ$$ and the others are here!!」

725:t_114:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Because $$ノノ$$ and the others are here!!」

725:t_115:0.en:
$$葵$$
「For people who call themselves gods, you sure do some petty stuff!」

725:t_115:1.en:
$$葵$$
「If you're out of cheap tricks, come at us by force! We'll crush you, pride and all!!」

725:t_116:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「You'll pay for what you did when you came to Earth and the other planets!」

725:t_116:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do it! A salaryman will take down a villain too, even if it's a god!」

725:t_117:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You arrogant dictators who call yourselves gods. It's time to pay for it.」
